dependabot.reason: The host application owns the installed Laravel version and lockfile; GitHub dependency alerts remain visible while the per-major Composer audit owns resolution and accepted-risk tracking for this library constraint.

9.reason: Laravel 9 has no fix for GHSA-f9x3-7vq9-cph6 (TokenGuard). Workflow 2.17.0 removes it from the supported constraint; Composer keeps Laravel 9 applications on Workflow 2.16.x until they upgrade the framework.

10.reason: Laravel 10 is outside upstream security support. Workflow 2.21.0 removes this major; retain the existing 2.20.x application lock while upgrading PHP to at least 8.2 and Laravel to a patched 12 or 13 release before taking 2.21.0. Existing 2.20.x legacy risks remain recorded in that release's dependency security policy.
